name: semantic-crosscheck
description: Cross-layer verification for an ontology plus semantic layer on PostgreSQL 17, for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Prove that a PostgreSQL closure, SHACL rules, OWL reasoning and a Cube model agree.
interface.longDescription: Release v0.4.0: cross-checks PostgreSQL 17 closures, SQL and SHACL rules, OWL/HermiT and Cube against gold SQL. Adds one REPEATABLE READ snapshot for multi-statement checks, a stated 95% detection bound for sampled V3 pair tests, additivity over many-to-one joins with an independent NULL-group check, a pinned and recorded Cube SQL planner, opt-in gold-independent BOM metamorphic relations, and SHACL comparison of colliding value kinds in extra groups. Errors, bounded agreement, missing or changed evidence cannot establish a PASS. Existing version 1 configurations remain supported; results recorded by 0.3.0 must be regenerated. No shared MVCC snapshot across Cube or stages and no runtime attestation is claimed.
defaultPrompt: Use semantic-crosscheck to run the synthetic demo end to end.
Use semantic-crosscheck to verify my crosscheck.toml against PostgreSQL and explain what is not proven.
